briefdescription.para: Driver for the Texas Instruments INA745A/B 40V, 16-Bit, Precision I2C Output Digital Power Monitor with integrated 800µΩ shunt (EZShunt).

detaileddescription.para:
Concept:
The driver core is bus-agnostic: it only uses injected HAL callbacks (ina745a_i2c_write_f / ina745a_i2c_read_f), never a concrete I2C driver directly. This allows host-side unit testing with stubs (see tests/ina745a/) without any BSP/hardware dependency, exactly like the si5332 driver.
The HAL callbacks operate on whole logical registers (1/2/3/5 bytes), MSB first, matching the INA745x register map. Their signature is intentionally identical to drivers/i2c/i2cWrapper's i2c_writeRegMultipleBytes()/i2c_readRegMultipleBytes(), so they can be passed directly to ina745a_initialize() via a function-pointer cast - no adapter module needed (same pattern as si5332 with i2c_writeReg/i2c_readReg). The core itself never includes i2cWrapper.h or any BSP header.
